summary: Piscataquis Co., Maine lookout built 1917-1919 (12 feet completed), no longer standing; the site now lies inside Baxter State Park.

facts.status_note: No longer standing per the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no removal date in the sources read

staffing.status: Patrol and lookout worked the mountain in 1919

events.note: A 16-foot steel tower was partly erected, to be finished in 1918
Completed 12-foot steel tower, in place by June 15, 1919
Patrol and lookout worked the mountain and built a bedroom onto the cabin
Registered September 15, 2008; nominated by Henry Isenberg

corrections.why: 4.9 m is 16 feet, the height given for the tower only partly erected in 1917. The 1919 annual report gives the completed tower as 12 feet, and the 1920 inventory agrees. 12 feet is about 3.7 m.

notes_for_editor: Brief height 4.9 m corrected to 3.7 m: 16 feet was the 1917 partly erected tower; the 1919 report and 1920 inventory give 12 feet. Build dates come from the Forest Lookouts quotes of annual reports and a Daily Kennebec Journal entry. A Facebook post dating construction to 1918 was not used. No removal date in any source read, so no removed event. Access not recorded: the sources place the site inside Baxter State Park and say nothing about visitor access. Two WebSearch calls and about five page reads.
